body:
Hello,
Send 5,000 units immediately. No need for details. We will confirm later.
This must be shipped within 24 hours.
Regards,
Tom
reply:
Subject: Re: Immediate Shipment Request

Hello Tom,

Thank you for your message. I understand the urgency regarding the shipment of 5,000 units.

However, could you please confirm your company location? This information is essential for us to process the order efficiently and ensure compliance with shipping regulations.

I appreciate your understanding and look forward to your prompt response.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
